tagline: The enterprise AI platform for managing people, money, and agents.
hero_kpi_rationale: Workday positions itself as an enterprise AI platform integrating AI into its HCM and financial solutions to enhance employee experience, productivity, and decision-making.

kpis.name: AI Positioning
kpis.explanation: Integration of artificial intelligence into solutions for managing people and finances.
kpis.description: Workday emphasizes AI to improve employee experience, productivity, and decision-making through AI agents and embedded models.
kpis.signal: Workday integrates AI into its solutions to transform business processes and solve complex problems.

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company.
kpis.description: Total revenues include subscription services and professional services revenues.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by subscription services.

kpis.name: Subscription Services Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from cloud-based subscription solutions.
kpis.description: Subscription services revenues represent the majority of total revenues and are recognized over the contract term.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in recurring revenues, the primary driver of performance.

kpis.name: GAAP Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin calculated under generally accepted accounting principles.
kpis.description: GAAP operating margin reflects the profitability of the company's core operations.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in GAAP operating margin.

kpis.name: Non-GAAP Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin excluding certain non-recurring or non-cash items.
kpis.description: Non-GAAP operating margin provides a view of underlying operational performance.
kpis.signal: Robust and growing non-GAAP operating margin.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flows
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flows are essential for funding operations and investments.
kpis.signal: Strong generation of operating cash flow.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flows
kpis.explanation: Cash available after deducting capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flows indicate the company's ability to repay debt, pay dividends, or reinvest.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in free cash flows.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees at the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is an indicator of the size and operational capacity of the company.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, reflecting controlled expansion.

kpis.name: Total Subscription Revenue Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed subscription contracts not yet recognized as revenue.
kpis.description: Total subscription revenue backlog is a leading indicator of future revenues.

kpis.name: 12-Month Subscription Revenue Backlog
kpis.explanation: Portion of total backlog expected to be recognized as revenue in the next 12 months.
kpis.description: The 12-month subscription revenue backlog provides visibility into short-term expected revenues.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in short-term subscription backlog.

kpis.name: Paradox Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Paradox, a company specializing in conversational AI for recruiting and candidate experience.
kpis.description: The Paradox acquisition strengthens Workday's AI capabilities in human capital management by integrating an AI-powered candidate agent based on conversational AI.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in conversational AI to streamline the hiring process and improve candidate experience.

kpis.name: Sana Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Sana, a company developing AI tools for enterprise knowledge and information management.
kpis.description: The Sana acquisition aims to improve information management and business process efficiency through the next generation of AI-powered enterprise knowledge tools.
kpis.signal: Enhancement of AI capabilities for enterprise knowledge management and improvement of financial processes.

risks.title: Technical infrastructure or cybersecurity failure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is ranked first among risk factors, with repeated mentions of critical disruptions, exposure of sensitive data, and recent incidents. The language is strong (materially and adversely affect, significant interruption). The Technology category has high weight in IT. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Increased competition from general AI
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights intensifying competition, particularly with the emergence of non-specialized AI solutions. Explicit mention of threats to product differentiation and market share loss. Alarming language used in risk factors. Competition category is critical in IT. Central placement in the 10-K.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party data centers
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail risks related to external data center providers. Critical dependencies on cloud providers and hosted infrastructures represent a major risk vector for service continuity.

ai_positioning.summary: Workday explicitly positions itself as an enterprise AI platform for managing people, finance, and agents. AI is embedded across all its HCM and financial solutions. Workday has announced new AI agents for fiscal 2026 and 2027 targeting hiring, frontline worker experience, financial processes, performance reviews, and workforce planning. Two major acquisitions (Paradox and Sana) strengthen AI capabilities in enterprise knowledge and conversational AI.
evidence: Item 1 Business: Workday is the enterprise AI platform for managing people, money, and agents
Workday AI is built into our platform, allowing us to rapidly deliver and sustain models that can transform business processes
In fiscal 2026, we introduced new Workday AI agents to accelerate hiring, enhance frontline worker experiences, simplify financial processes, and improve employee information access
New Workday AI agents expected in fiscal 2027 for HCM and finance processes such as performance reviews, workforce planning, and financial close
Acquisition of Paradox (September 2025, $1.1B) for conversational AI in hiring
Acquisition of Sana (November 2025, $1.1B) for next generation of enterprise knowledge tools
